newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn basis down, soybeans steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn basis down, soybeans steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn basis values were lower late Thursday in reaction to improved barge movement to the U.S. Gulf and increased farmer selling, grain dealers said.
However, export demand for corn remained light, they said.
Basis values for soybeans were steady after dropping Wednesday. Hard and soft red winter wheat values were unchanged.
U.S. exporters and grain traders relayed talk that Iraq bought between 25,000 and 75,000 tonnes of hard red winter wheat, but the deal could not be confirmed.
